csharpCode: var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder(); var teleporters = UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectsByType<TeleporterNode>(UnityEngine.FindObjectsInactive.Include, UnityEngine.FindObjectsSortMode.None); int groundLayerMask = UnityEngine.LayerMask.GetMask("Ground"); sb.AppendLine($"Ground LayerMask: {groundLayerMask}"); foreach (var t in teleporters) { var hit = UnityEngine.Physics2D.Raycast(t.transform.position, UnityEngine.Vector2.down, 100f, groundLayerMask); sb.AppendLine($"Teleporter {t.nodeName} at {t.transform.position}:"); if (hit.collider != null) { sb.AppendLine($"  -> Found Ground: {hit.collider.name} at {hit.point} (dist: {t.transform.position.y - hit.point.y})"); } else { sb.AppendLine("  -> NO GROUND IN GROUND LAYER WITHIN 100 UNITS!"); } } UnityEngine.Debug.Log(sb.ToString());
